name: homepod-sender
description: 把电脑声音实时推送到 HomePod（AirPlay 2）
author: HomePodSender

scripts.sidecar: dotnet publish ../Sidecar/HomePodSidecar.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o sidecar-publish
scripts.e2e: dotnet build ../Ap2Cli/Ap2Cli.csproj -v q && npm run sidecar:debug && npm run build && node scripts/e2e.mjs
